complete mixed ghost, antighost and Nakanishi-Lautrup vertices
field-space measure and Jacobians for connection/contorsion and irreducible decompositions
complete covariant Senjanovic determinant or proved first-class conversion; one canonical bracket block is not the full measure
continuation and contours for noncompact gauge directions, conformal factor, auxiliaries and multipliers
regulator, subtraction, full invariant basis and quotient by topology, equations of motion, redefinitions and BRST-exact terms
counterterm-to-critical-normal projection plus source or observable matching convention
